result:
Compilation succeeded.

I created `tests/org/apache/commons/lang3/text/ExtendedMessageFormatAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 5 test class covering:

- All four constructors (plain pattern, with locale, with registry, with locale+registry), including null-registry fallback behavior
- `IllegalArgumentException` on malformed patterns and unknown format types (per the documented `throws` clause)
- Locale-sensitive formatting and custom `FormatFactory` registry usage (with a small self-contained upper-casing `Format`/`FormatFactory` fixture)
- `applyPattern` updating formatting behavior and rejecting bad patterns
- `toPattern` round-tripping a simple pattern
- All four disabled mutators (`setFormat`, `setFormatByArgumentIndex`, `setFormats`, `setFormatsByArgumentIndex`) always throwing `UnsupportedOperationException` as documented
- `equals`/`hashCode` contract (reflexivity, equality for same pattern/locale, inequality for different pattern/null/wrong type)
- Inherited `Cloneable`/`Serializable` markers and `clone()` producing a distinct-but-equal instance
- Inherited `choice` subformat pass-through behavior

`./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`, no other files were modified.
